hero.title: Run your gym on one platform.
hero.subtitle: CiCiByte SGMS brings member CRM, PT programs, POS & accounts, and athlete mobile experience into a premium, international, scalable SaaS.

features.title: Physical gym + digital operations together
features.subtitle: From front desk to coach to athlete app — one shared data layer for your team.

crm.title: Member CRM & Metrics
crm.description: Profiles, avatars, health measurements and membership plans with a clear staff view.

programs.title: Workout & Nutrition
programs.description: PT assignments, workout and nutrition programs with instant athlete portal access.

pt.title: PT Performance & Commission
pt.description: Monthly session count, hours, revenue, and commission calculated automatically for every trainer — cancellation and no-show rate included.

pos.title: POS & Member Accounts
pos.description: Market, café and extra session charges. Collections, daily cash summary and balances.

reports.title: Ətraflı Hesabat & Biznes Analitikası

why.title: Spreadsheets and WhatsApp don't scale a gym

athlete.description: Members expect digital access to programs, metrics and balance. SGMS delivers via the athlete portal.
